description: Five floors of flats on the end of the terrace, and the only block on this side of the park with a park view, which the letting board mentions in larger letters than anything else. Someone painted STATUE QUO over the door in a serif they did not have the wrist for. The ground-floor windows are barred, the second-floor ones are not, and the top two floors have window boxes that are doing better than they have any right to.
name: Statue Quo
